author_mathematical_scope: Operate on quantities written in scientific notation, including mixed decimal-and-scientific-notation problems; select suitably scaled units for extremely large or small measurements; and interpret scientific-notation output produced by technology.
required_material_conditions: problems mixing decimal notation and scientific notation
scientific notation used together with appropriately scaled measurement units
both very large and very small quantities
candidate_selection_rule: Include only registered canonical families whose learner-facing contract explicitly presents scientific notation and performs or prepares an operation required by 8.EE.A.4. Generic exponent, place-value, decimal, estimation, or arithmetic families do not qualify merely because they can support the mathematics. Unregistered draft target labels are evidence of proposed work, not canonical candidates.
